newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates plunged on Saturday amid high liquidity, and dealers said the market could retain its liquid status over Tuesday unless the central bank conducted a special open market operation.
"The prevailing liquid conditions, with an inflow of about 1.50 billion rupees, put extra pressure on the overnight rates," a dealer at KASB & Co said.

"Early deals were struck at 4.0 percent, but the rates eased later and heavy amounts were dealt at around 2.50 percent." One-month bids and offers were at 12.25 and 13 percent, but some offers changed hands at 12.60 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
